text: bhikkhave khandhadhātuāyatanā tampi na maññeyya tasmiṃpi na maññeyya tatopi na maññeyya taṃ meti na maññeyya . so evaṃ amaññamāno na kiñci loke upādiyati anupādiyaṃ na paritassati aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . aṭṭhamaṃ . [123] dvayaṃ vo bhikkhave desissāmi . taṃ suṇātha . kiñca 1 bhikkhave dvayaṃ cakkhuñceva rūpā ca sotañca 2 saddā ca ghānañca gandhā ca jivhā ca rasā ca kāyo ca
